values.name: Use of Hard-coded Password

evidence.explanation: Runtime datasource and administrator passwords are required environment/property values, not literal password defaults (application.properties:10-14; SecurityConfig:34-39; docker-compose.yml:7-10,35-38). Oracle initialization consumes required environment variables. .env.example contains labeled replacement placeholders, not an actual deployed credential. No literal credential values reproduced.

values.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key

evidence.explanation: No application encryption/signing key constants, SecretKeySpec, keystore password/key material or hard-coded cryptographic key found. BCryptPasswordEncoder generates credential hashes; no fixed cryptographic key configured.

values.description: The product uses a hard-coded, unchangeable cryptographic key.

values.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment for Critical Resource

evidence.explanation: Upload/delete require authentication (SecurityConfig:53-55); public gallery read is explicitly intended. Oracle scripts grant application-schema creation privileges without DBA or ANY-system-wide grants. No confirmed incorrectly assigned critical-resource permission; runtime filesystem ACLs and cloud/IAM policies were not available.

values.description: The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.

values.name: Insufficient Logging

evidence.explanation: SecurityConfig uses the default HTTP Basic authentication entry point with no failure/access-denied audit handler or AuthenticationFailure event listener, and the repository has no authentication-audit listener or access-log configuration. Authentication failures occur before controller/service logging. Upload/delete success logs contain filenames/IDs but omit the authenticated principal, preventing actor attribution for destructive actions. Static assessment confirms missing application audit instrumentation; external proxy/SIEM logging was not available for verification.

values.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

values.name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

evidence.explanation: Administrator and datasource authentication secrets are supplied from required environment/property values; fixed username defaults alone do not authenticate. Oracle scripts consume injected credentials. No actual hard-coded runtime authentication secret found; example placeholders are explicitly documented as needing replacement.

values.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.
